elements.text: Morphing Search is a pair of animated search components for React, built with Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS. Morphing Search turns a search field or a compact search icon into a results panel that grows out of the same shell, opened by a click or a single-key shortcut, and folds back on close. Chip Search is a docked search bar that widens on focus, unfolds a recent searches and suggestions panel from its own edge, and turns each term into a removable chip that the bar grows to fit.When to use itA site header needs a small search icon that expands into full results without navigating to a search page.A product catalog or file browser filters by several terms at once and shows each active filter as a chip.An app wants to remember recent searches and offer suggestions as the user types.AccessibilityBoth use a combobox input that tracks the active option through aria-activedescendant, with results in a listbox. Morphing Search opens as a modal dialog, traps Tab inside it, closes with Escape and returns focus to where it was; its shortcut is ignored while typing in another field. Chip Search adds Enter to add a chip, a two step Backspace that first selects and then removes the last chip, arrow keys to move between chips, Delete to remove a highlighted recent search, Escape that clears the query before closing, and polite announcements. With reduced motion enabled, the morphs and chip springs are replaced by instant or fade-only changes.FAQHow do I make an expanding search bar in React?Install @beui/morphing-search and render MorphingSearch with an items array of id and title objects. Add iconOnly to start from a compact icon, and handle picks with onSelect or each item's own onSelect.How do I build a search with filter chips?Install @beui/morphing-search-chips and render MorphingSearchChips with suggestions. Use chips with onChipsChange for controlled filters, maxChips to cap them, and storageKey to keep recent searches in localStorage.Can I use server-side search results?Yes. On MorphingSearchChips, set filter={false} to show your suggestions as given, update them from onQueryChange, and set loading while the request runs. On MorphingSearch, onQueryChange reports each query so you can replace items.
